name: Detach Worker Domain
description: Detach Worker Domain Detaches a domain from a Worker. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains/{domain_id}

name: Get Worker Domain
description: Get Worker Domain Gets information about a Worker domain. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains/{domain_id}

name: List Worker Domains
description: List Worker Domains Lists all Worker domains for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains
Lists all Worker domains for an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: zone_id (query); zone_name (query); service (query); hostname (query); environment (query)

name: Attach Worker Domain
description: Attach Worker Domain Attaches a domain that routes traffic to a Worker. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/domains
Attaches a domain that routes traffic to a Worker.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
